roleExpectation: same-provider model override only; role model_provider must not change the provider (ADR-0003)

isolation.required: OS-level egress isolation (network namespace or host-level block)
isolation.current: BLOCKED_ENV: bwrap/unshare unavailable; curated plugin sync risk cannot be excluded

cases.assert: child runs a read-only tool and the nonce reaches the parent wait notification
wait_agent receives the native completion notification; no timeout before child final
followup_task starts a new child turn and the new nonce returns to the parent
send_message is routed as a namespace collaboration tool with plaintext projection
cancel prevents further followup and yields a canceled terminal, not a fake success
denied tool permission is reported and no tool executes
allowed tool permission executes once with the expected nonce
resume returns the same root SID and reuses the existing child id/history
fork_turns=none child starts without parent history
fork_turns=all child receives the parent history in order
native concurrency limit rejects the over-limit spawn with a typed error
root/child ids are distinct and linked; no gateway-invented child
requests hit only loopback mocks; no external connect

regressions.historical: After wiring, the local run reached 22/27 checks and round 2 returned 502 candidate pool empty; not accepted as PASS.
regressions.assert: round 2 must not return 502; an empty candidate pool must produce a typed/readable diagnosis
regressions.reopen: Q02 on a host with enforced egress isolation

notes: This manifest is declarative. It does not run Codex and does not claim PASS.
Real lifecycle execution belongs to Q02 and requires OS-level egress isolation; bwrap/unshare is unavailable here.
The role fixture is the P01 negative fixture: model_provider in a role is ignored, provider is inherited.
